claim: OS icon in the prompt is broken: STARSHIP_DISTRO is exported as an empty string on both OSes because the glyphs are missing from the template bytes
proposed_fix: Delete the export and the [env_var.STARSHIP_DISTRO] block; enable Starship's built-in [os] module (disabled = false)
expected_impact: Restores the documented OS/distro symbol with zero shell-side plumbing

claim: Documented per-machine override mechanism (~/.chezmoidata/local.toml) does not exist in chezmoi; gitSigningKey is hardcoded empty, so the SSH signing template block is unreachable
proposed_fix: gitSigningKey = {{ promptStringOnce . "gitSigningKey" "SSH signing key (empty to skip)" "" | quote }}; delete .chezmoiignore:5-6; rewrite README 'Datos de chezmoi locales' to chezmoi edit-config
expected_impact: SSH commit signing becomes enableable per machine without editing tracked files

claim: timezone is prompted at init but no template references .timezone
proposed_fix: Remove the prompt (or use it via export TZ if a consumer appears)
expected_impact: One fewer question on init; removes a phantom variable from CLAUDE.md

claim: Oh My Zsh is sourced but never installed by any script, Brewfile, or README step; on a fresh machine every OMZ plugin alias (g*, k*, tf*) is missing
proposed_fix: Add .chezmoiexternal.toml with the archive entry for ohmyzsh (stripComponents = 1, refreshPeriod = 168h); drop zstyle ':omz:update' lines
expected_impact: Fresh-machine shell matches the documented one; OMZ updates ride chezmoi apply

claim: No managed file puts Homebrew on PATH; the shell works on this machine only because of an unmanaged ~/.zprofile. On a fresh Apple Silicon Mac or any Linux box, BREW_PREFIX is empty and starship/mise/direnv/zoxide evals print 'command not found' on every shell start; README step 2 (brew install chezmoi) also fails right after step 1
proposed_fix: Template BREW_PREFIX per OS/arch in dot_config/shell/paths and prepend $BREW_PREFIX/bin:$BREW_PREFIX/sbin; delete the brew --prefix fork; guard the four evals with command -v; README: add eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)" between steps 1 and 2
expected_impact: Bootstrap works on both OSes without unmanaged files; one fewer subprocess per shell

claim: Mac App Store apps never install on first run (mas is installed by the same bundle the script checks it before) and the README recovery step 're-run chezmoi apply' is a no-op for a run_onchange script
proposed_fix: Move the mas list to its own run_onchange_after_install-mas-apps.sh.tmpl (hash only mas lines, runs after brew); fix the warning text; README recovery = chezmoi state delete-bucket --bucket=scriptState && chezmoi apply
expected_impact: mas apps install during the first apply on a signed-in Mac; documented recovery actually works

claim: README promises aliases kctx, projects, teaching, rec and the tool agg (teaching workflow) and mdbook; none exist in .zshrc, OMZ plugins, or any Brewfile
proposed_fix: Add the four aliases to .zshrc; add agg and asciinema/vhs to the shared Brewfile; delete mdbook from README
expected_impact: README 'Flujo de Trabajo de Docencia' works as written

claim: Docs claim GCP/AWS/Azure tooling; no azure-cli or google-cloud-sdk in any Brewfile (the .zshrc gcloud block sources a cask that is never installed) and no Starship [azure] module
proposed_fix: Either add cask google-cloud-sdk, brew azure-cli and [azure] to starship.toml, or change README/CLAUDE.md to 'GCP + AWS' (open question Q-2)
expected_impact: Multi-cloud claim becomes true or honest

claim: Linux support is declared deliberate but has never been exercised (TODO.md) and there is no CI; three Linux-only defects were found by reading
proposed_fix: GitHub Actions: chezmoi init --source . --apply --dry-run --verbose with --promptString values on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest; shellcheck rendered scripts; starship print-config must be warning-free
expected_impact: Linux regressions are caught on push instead of on the next Linux machine

claim: private_dot_claude/settings.json is never deployed: .chezmoiignore:12 excludes .claude/settings.json and chezmoi managed does not list it; CLAUDE.md says it is the one managed file under ~/.claude
proposed_fix: Per Checkpoint 2: delete private_dot_claude/ and fix CLAUDE.md:17 and :43; keep the ignore line
expected_impact: Removes a dead file and a false doc claim; machine-specific hooks stay local

claim: README.md and CLAUDE.md are deployed into $HOME (chezmoi managed lists both; ~/README.md and ~/CLAUDE.md exist), so ~/CLAUDE.md is loaded as project instructions by every Claude Code session under $HOME
proposed_fix: Add README.md, CLAUDE.md, AUDIT_REPORT.md, ROADMAP.md, audit_findings.json to .chezmoiignore; remove the stray ~/README.md and ~/CLAUDE.md
expected_impact: Stops leaking repo docs into the home directory and into unrelated Claude sessions

claim: .chezmoiignore has entries that can never match a target: .chezmoidata/local.toml, .chezmoidata/secrets.yml (see unimplemented-002) and .gitignore (chezmoi already ignores every dot-prefixed source file)
proposed_fix: Delete the three lines
expected_impact: Ignore file states only real intent

claim: mise is activated twice per shell: .zshrc evals mise activate zsh and the enabled OMZ mise plugin runs the identical eval
proposed_fix: Delete dot_zshrc.tmpl:83-84
expected_impact: One fewer subprocess and one fewer PATH mutation per shell start

claim: Both Homebrew bootstrap scripts eval brew shellenv after install and then only echo; each chezmoi script is its own process so the PATH change is dead, and the comment justifying it is wrong
proposed_fix: Delete the eval blocks and the 'clean environment' comments
expected_impact: Removes 14 misleading lines

claim: Linux packages script filters ^cask/^mas lines from a Brewfile that contains zero such lines, and runs a box-wide brew upgrade that is redundant with brew bundle's default upgrade and broader than the Brewfile
proposed_fix: Delete the grep filters and the brew upgrade line; add || true to match the darwin failure policy
expected_impact: Removes dead code; one failing formula no longer aborts the whole chezmoi apply on Linux; no unrequested upgrades

claim: The Ghostty Application Support symlink loads the same file twice: Ghostty on macOS already reads $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ghostty/config.ghostty (docs), and ghostty +show-config prints every key twice
proposed_fix: Delete private_Library/ and the Library/** block in .chezmoiignore (assumption A-4: no reliance on the macOS 'Open Config' path)
expected_impact: Removes a whole OS-special-case directory tree and an ignore rule

claim: dot_vscode/argv.json manages only a VS Code default (enable-crash-reporter: true) and a machine-specific crash-reporter-id UUID that is now cloned to every machine
proposed_fix: Delete dot_vscode/ and ignore .vscode/**
expected_impact: Stops sharing a per-install identifier; removes a file that carries no configuration

claim: Comment.nvim duplicates Neovim's built-in gc operator (present since 0.10; machine runs 0.12.5)
proposed_fix: Delete init.lua:111
expected_impact: One fewer plugin to clone and update

claim: Brewfile duplicates: three Docker VS Code extensions, two CSV extensions, font-monaspace plus font-monaspice-nerd-font, 14 Nerd Fonts while Ghostty uses one; plus out-of-scope entries flagged for review (rabbitmq, cocoapods, mysqlworkbench/pgadmin4/dbeaver, watson, llmfit, openai-whisper, ollama)
proposed_fix: Keep ms-azuretools.vscode-containers (+ docker.docker if wanted), one CSV extension, one Monaspace; decide per item on the rest
expected_impact: Faster brew bundle; smaller surface to keep current

claim: gemini-cli Homebrew formula is deprecated (brew info: deprecated=true) and will stop installing when disabled
proposed_fix: Install via npm/mise or drop the entry
expected_impact: Avoids a future brew bundle failure

claim: GitHub and GitLab SSH host blocks restate IdentityFile, IdentitiesOnly, AddKeysToAgent and UseKeychain that Host * already sets; ssh -G shows identical effective values
proposed_fix: Trim each block to User git + PreferredAuthentications publickey
expected_impact: 16 fewer lines; one place to change identity settings

claim: Stale comments: .zshrc says the managed paths file must be created manually; init.lua carries 'replaces NERDTree/vim-polyglot/lightline/NERDCommenter/delimitMate' notes from a deleted vimrc
proposed_fix: Delete or correct the comments
expected_impact: Comments stop contradicting the repo

claim: dot_zshrc.tmpl (9 commits) guards fzf with command -v but not starship/mise/direnv/zoxide, and forks brew --prefix for a value known at template time
proposed_fix: Template BREW_PREFIX per OS/arch in dot_config/shell/paths; guard the four evals uniformly; delete the duplicate mise eval
expected_impact: Shell survives missing tools; no per-shell fork; single source of truth for the brew prefix

claim: Two near-identical package scripts (darwin: 6 commits) and two near-identical Homebrew bootstrap scripts differ only in OS-specific blocks, and have accidentally diverged in failure policy (|| true vs hard-fail) and upgrade policy
proposed_fix: One run_onchange_before_install-packages.sh.tmpl and one run_once_before_install-homebrew.sh.tmpl using {{ if eq .chezmoi.os "darwin" }} blocks; one error policy
expected_impact: Future Brewfile-handling changes land once; Linux stops aborting the whole apply on a single bad formula

claim: credential.helper = osxkeychain is rendered unconditionally; on Linux every HTTPS git operation warns 'credential-osxkeychain is not a git command'. The OMZ macos plugin is likewise loaded on Linux
proposed_fix: Wrap both in {{ if eq .chezmoi.os "darwin" }}; optional Linux helper cache --timeout=3600
expected_impact: Clean git output on Linux

claim: init.lua sets clipboard = "unnamed", which is the system clipboard on macOS but the PRIMARY selection on Linux
proposed_fix: clipboard = "unnamedplus" (system clipboard on both)
expected_impact: Yank/paste reaches the system clipboard on Linux

claim: Global core.hooksPath disables every repo-local hook framework, including the pre-commit and commitlint the Brewfile installs: pre-commit 4.6.2 refuses to install with 'Cowardly refusing to install hooks with core.hooksPath set'
proposed_fix: Make the global pre-commit hook chain to $(git rev-parse --git-path hooks)/pre-commit when present, or drop hooksPath and add gitleaks per repo via pre-commit
expected_impact: gitleaks and per-repo hooks both run

claim: KexAlgorithms pins only curve25519-sha256@libssh.org, dropping OpenSSH's post-quantum defaults (mlkem768x25519-sha256, sntrup761x25519-sha512) that this client (10.3) supports
proposed_fix: KexAlgorithms mlkem768x25519-sha256,sntrup761x25519-sha512,curve25519-sha256 — or delete the line and keep the client default
expected_impact: Post-quantum key exchange where servers support it; no regression elsewhere

claim: nvim-treesitter is pinned to the locked master branch (deliberate); main requires Neovim 0.12 and the machine runs 0.12.5
proposed_fix: Later: rewrite init.lua:88-102 for the main branch (no configs module / ensure_installed)
expected_impact: Stays on the maintained branch before master bit-rots

claim: No LSP for the languages treesitter already highlights (terraform, yaml, python, go); Neovim 0.11+ has a native client that needs no plugin
proposed_fix: vim.lsp.config/vim.lsp.enable for terraform-ls, yaml-language-server, pyright, gopls; binaries via mise
expected_impact: Diagnostics and navigation for the primary IaC/K8s workflow

claim: README contradicts code: robbyrussell theme (Starship is used), a versions table that is stale on every row (mise uses latest; TF 1.15.7 vs 1.14.7 within the same README; Poetry/Ruff not mise-managed), 'casks comunes' in a Brewfile with none, asciinema/vhs listed as general but macOS-only
proposed_fix: Rewrite README 'Arquitectura' shell line, replace the versions table with 'latest via mise' (or delete it), fix the Brewfile table
expected_impact: README stops promising things the repo doesn't do

claim: CLAUDE.md says the Neovim config has no plugin manager; init.lua bootstraps lazy.nvim. CLAUDE.md pins Terraform 1.15.7 while the live machine has 1.15.9 (Checkpoint 2: bump the repo pin, keep flutter local)
proposed_fix: Fix CLAUDE.md:26; set terraform = "1.15.9" in mise config; move the live flutter entry to ~/.config/mise/config.local.toml
expected_impact: Agent instructions and source match reality; drift cleared

claim: README omits the most useful implemented features: mise tasks (tf-check, tf-docs, k8s-check, secrets-check), Neovim keymaps, git aliases, and the managed paths file
proposed_fix: Add a short table for each to README (Spanish)
expected_impact: Implemented features are discoverable
